column3: “satisfied with life” supplies “with life” for “satisfied”; “breathed his last” renders “expired.”
“the records of the generations” renders “the toledot.”
“he settled in defiance of” renders “he fell (settled) over against.”
“the records of the generations” renders “the toledot.”
“Paddan-aram” is transliterated; “the Aramean” is used for both Bethuel and Laban.
“why then am I this way?” renders “why am I this?”, a terse question.
“a peaceful man” renders “a tam man” (complete, quiet).
“he had a taste for game” renders “game was in his mouth.”
“a swallow of that red stuff” renders “let me gulp some of the red, this red,” explaining the name “Edom.”
